name: Retuerta del Bullaque (Spain)
description: Quartered white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Retuerta del Bullaque (a castle on red above a wavy fess).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 23 August 1990 (Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha no. 62 of 29 August 1990); the flag is described as quartered.

features.role: Retuerta del Bullaque arms — castle above a wavy fess
